verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Engine is published as an npm package (`npm install playcanvas`), with scaffolding via `create-playcanvas`, ESM-based scripting recommended for new projects, and companion npm packages (@playcanvas/react, @playcanvas/web-components) that build on the engine declaratively — all consistent with standard JS toolchain import/bundle workflows. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation or independent confirmation of tree-shaking support or bundler-specific guidance (e.g., webpack/Vite tree-shaking behavior), and some community comments (older, possibly outdated) mention ES6/NPM support was still in progress historically.
